entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: East India Company, a political institution in Bangladesh during Mughal Bengal and Economic Powerhouse (1700–1757). Grew from British East India Company and Akbar. Led to the emergence of Nawab Siraj ud-Daulah captures Calcutta and the Black Hole incident and Great Bengal Famine kills an estimated 10 million people under Company misrule.
